_v1_notes.INTERDICTING PARTY|LEGAL BASIS: coast guard x UNSC mandate is N: a mandate authorises action beyond national waters, which a coast guard neither reaches nor is empowered to sustain. Contractor x territorial enforcement and x mandate are both N: each confers state authority a contractor cannot hold. Contractor x no basis is Y - the documented mercenary case. Coalition x territorial enforcement is N: a coalition inside one state's own 12nm zone is that state's own business.
_v1_notes.INTERDICTING PARTY|TARGET VESSEL: anyone x foreign naval auxiliary is N except a naval task force, because sovereign immunity means only a peer state vessel can lawfully challenge it and survive the escalation. Contractor x fishing fleet is N: civilian crews plus armed contractors is politically incoherent.
_v1_notes.INTERDICTING PARTY|OUTCOME SOUGHT: coast guard x destruction of cargo is N: police powers do not extend to destroying property at sea. Contractor x seizure and prosecution is N: no arrest power. Contractor x destruction is N: no authority to use force against property.
_v1_notes.LEGAL BASIS|TARGET VESSEL: territorial enforcement x foreign naval auxiliary is N: sovereign immunity survives inside territorial waters. Flag-state consent x unflagged craft is N: there is no flag state to consent. Flag-state consent x naval auxiliary is N for the same immunity reason. No basis x registered freighter is N: an owner with legal recourse makes an unlawful boarding untenable; no basis x fishing fleet is N on political sensitivity.
_v1_notes.LEGAL BASIS|OUTCOME SOUGHT: territorial and flag-state consent x destruction of cargo are N: lawful bases support seizure, not destruction. No basis x seizure and prosecution is N: no court will take a case built on an unlawful boarding.
_v1_notes.TARGET VESSEL|OUTCOME SOUGHT: naval auxiliary x seizure is N and x destruction is N: both mean war with the flag state. Fishing fleet x destruction is N: civilian crews.
